questions.stem: If the capital of partners is fixed, then the salary provided to the partner is posted in which of the following account?

match.front: Fixed vs Fluctuating capital: the difference on items related to the deed (drawings, salary, interest on capital).

Fixed Capital
Drawings, salary, interest on capital, etc. are posted (transfered) in the current accounts and not in the capital accounts.
Fluctuating Capital
All adjustments for drawings, salary, interest on capital, etc., are posted (transfered) in the capital accounts.

At the time of the dissolution of a partnership firm in which X, Y and Z were partners sharing profit in 2:2:1 ratio, the following information was made available. Arrange them in the sequence in which they will be paid.
(A) A's Loan to the firm Rs 50,000
(B) Creditors Rs 2,00,000
(C) A's Capital Rs 2,50,000, B's Capital Rs 2,00,000 and C's Capital Rs 1,00,000
(D) Balance available after settlement of all the stakeholders
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

match.front: Steps: the order in which the firm’s assets are applied on dissolution.
match.back:
(i) In paying the debts of the firm to the third parties
(ii) In paying each partner proportionately what is due to him/her from the firm for advances as distinguished from capital (i.e. partner’ loan)
(iii) In paying to each partner proportionately what is due to him on account of capital
(iv) the residue, if any, shall be divided among the partners in their profit sharing ratio
match.source: NCERT, Accountancy Part 1 (Partnership Accounts), chapter 4, page 159

questions.stem: The current ratio of a firm is 2 : 1. If the firm purchased goods on credit, then how will it affect its current ratio?
options: The ratio will increase for some time and reach its highest point.

match.front: Current ratio is 2:1. Effect of purchasing goods on credit on the ratio?
match.back: Assume that goods of Rs. 10,000 are purchased on credit. This will increase the current assets to Rs. 60,000 and current liabilities to Rs. 35,000. The new ratio will be 1.7:1 (Rs. 60,000/Rs. 35,000). Hence, it has reduced.
match.source: NCERT, Accountancy: Company Accounts and Analysis of Financial Statements, chapter 5, page 204

questions.stem: Which of the following arguments in a financial function represents the total number of payments?

match.front: Name the 5 parameters of Excel's PMT function.
match.back:
Rate: Interest rate per period for the loan
Nper: Total number of payments for the loan.
Pv: Present value, i.e. the loan amount
Fv: Future value, which is taken as 0, is the balance at the end of the loan period
Type: Whether payment is made at the beginning (value=1) or at the end (value=0) of the period
